entries.text: There Will Be Blood — ambition as oil: it blackens everything it touches.
Whiplash — the conservatory as coliseum; greatness demanded at drumstick-point.
The Social Network — empire-building one dorm-room betrayal at a time.
Nightcrawler — a man who treats the city as a market and himself as product.
Gattaca — ambition against biology itself, won on sheer refusal.

versions.message: Finally wrote down the canon after years of arguing about it.

lists.title: Morning rituals that actually survived contact with reality

entries.text: Coffee brewed slowly, drunk before any screen wakes up.
Twenty minutes of reading something long — no feeds allowed at this hour.
A short walk around the block while the street is still empty.
Writing three sentences about the day ahead; more than three becomes homework.

versions.message: Recording the ritual so I stop pretending I will remember it.
